From:  Beth Aboulafia
To:  Christine Rivera
Subject:  9/6/2023 Planning Commission Meeting - Agenda Item 6a (Target Corporation)
Date:  Monday, September 4, 2023 11:00:55 AM

To the Honorable Planning Commissioners:

I represent Target Corporation with respect to the alcoholic beverage licensing of its stores in
California.

I extend my apologies to the Commissioners for not being able to attend the hearing this evening.
However I am currently out of state on a trip that has been planned since last year.

Target has complied with all of the conditions of its Special Use Permit for alcohol sales and, as
confirmed by the Inglewood Police Department, there have been no law enforcement issues as a
result of Target’s sale of alcoholic beverages since the approval of the SUP.   Target will continue to
ensure that alcohol sales are conducted in a responsible manner.

Respectfully,

Beth Aboulafia
Partner I Hinman & Carmichael LLP
260 California Street, Suite 700, San Francisco, CA 94111
P: 415.362.1215 x104 I F: 415.362.1494 I E: aboulafia@beveragelaw.com
